name: Progress measurements
annotation: HIFI-90 · /progress · dark shell with top radial orange glow; TrendStageHero (GlassStatCard.hero) is the singular focal moment merging value + chart + metric tabs, keeping the trend calm and shame-free per canon's dense-content rule.

modules.build: Title 'Progress' left. Icon add right (opens Add measurement sheet). Icon gear right (settings).

GlassStatCard.hero r40 glow-you orange. Overline 'WEIGHT TREND'. Display34 '176.4 lb'. Body15 'down 1.2 this month'. ChipProvenance 'via smart scale · Jul 6'. TrendChart 280h: axis 180/176/172, solid orange real line, dashed purple projection, green milestone dots, x-axis May Jun Jul. Metric tabs: Weight active, BMI, Measurements.
KPIRow: 'BMI 24.8', 'Waist 33.1 in', 'Photos 4'. SyncStatus 'Last sync 2h ago'. Body goals embed text: 'Body goals: waist target 62%'.
ConsentCard SolidCard: 'Photos are private by default'. BtnPrimary 'Open'. BtnGhost 'Privacy'. HIFI-90-01 photo compare stays hidden until consent.
CIAInsightCard glow-cia purple: 'CIA: weight changed alongside sleep. Keep the *pace* steady.'

belowFold: History list, y830 h120: ListRow 'History' title; ledger rows 'Jul 6', 'Jun 29', 'Jun 22' continue below the CIA insight card, no items cut off — only scrolled past the 844 fold.
imageSlots: HIFI-90-01 progress photo compare placeholder (hidden until consent)
trustControls: Weight: real value with ChipProvenance date/source; low-confidence 'estimated · low confidence' for stale/imported data; honest-null 'Not enough data yet - 3 more days.'
BMI: calculated from height and weight; low-confidence if height or recent weight is missing; honest-null links to profile height.
Body measurements: manual source only — no fake inferred circumferences.
Photos: consented private media; upload pending state; no thumbnails shown in honest-null state; retention and backups labeled.
CIA: no causal claims without multi-signal evidence; premium trend windows and CIA body-pattern analysis use PaywallLock, generic preview unless consent and entitlement both exist.
Add sheet explains what is stored and how it can be deleted.
Photo privacy sheet: open, revoke access, delete selected photos, export, retention window, encrypted storage/backups, not used for model training, no human review by default, no default sharing.
Body language avoids shame, diagnosis, and moral scoring; health source chips link to revoke/delete provider data.
notes: Chart-first focal stage; TrendStageHero merges value, chart, and metric tabs into one focal moment per spec. No revealing thumbnails pre-consent. CIA requires multi-signal evidence before any causal claim. Yearly trend and CIA body-pattern analysis use PaywallLock blur + single orange CTA, generic preview unless consent and entitlement both exist. TopBar add icon (not a FAB — none exists in spec) opens the Add measurement sheet, which locks units/source labels to avoid layout shift. Route stays /progress; /goals/body is not a live route — body goals remain an embed linking to the repaired Goals route later.
